players.product: Front-end photoresist coater/developer tracks (offline, I-line, KrF, ArF immersion), front-end single-wafer chemical and physical cleaning tools, and advanced-packaging coater/developer, wet and temporary bonding/debonding tools

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 896.8 million (+26.47% YoY) as customer acceptances progressed; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 8.06 million (-49.37%); net loss excluding non-recurring items RMB 45.14 million, on higher staff costs and lower government subsidies. R&D investment RMB 153.5 million (+16.22%), 17.11% of revenue. Operating cash flow was RMB -450.7 million as purchase payments rose with a growing order backlog. Accounts payable rose 42.93% on higher material purchases.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 896.8 million (+26.47%); net profit attributable RMB 8.06 million (-49.37%)

quarterly_data.signal: Orders: front-end coater/developer tracks kept winning orders from leading domestic logic, memory and power customers, with offline, I-line and KrF tools showing good volume-production data at multiple customers (the line also includes ArF immersion). The high-temperature SPM chemical cleaner passed process qualification at a leading domestic customer and the chemical cleaner won repeat orders from several large domestic customers with fast new-order growth; the front-end physical cleaner won volume orders from a leading domestic customer and a high-throughput version passed a memory customer's qualification with repeat orders; back-end coater/developer and wet tools won repeat volume orders from leading packaging customers.

Advanced packaging: Kingsemi's fully automatic temporary bonding and debonding tools, aimed at chiplet InFO, CoWoS and HBM 2.5D/3D processes (60 micron and thicker adhesive coatings), won orders from several domestic customers in H1, passed multiple customers' process qualification and entered full volume production; its new Frame cleaning tool for 2.5D/3D packaging passed customer qualification and is ramping.

Kingsemi.why: China's main domestic supplier of front-end photoresist coater/developer tracks (KrF / ArF immersion) and single-wafer cleaning tools, plus temporary bonding/debonding tools for CoWoS and HBM packaging; sales rise with domestic fab and advanced-packaging builds.
Kingsemi.evidence: Kingsemi half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026): front-end coater/developer tracks kept winning orders from leading domestic logic, memory and power customers; temporary bonding/debonding tools for InFO, CoWoS and HBM entered full volume production.
